description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. The `ask` envelope is a PUBLISHED tool contract that no vector pinned, and AGSC-09-14a admitted two readings before rc.5 (V9D-07): `citations[]` as a sixth top-level member with `body` a string, or `citations[]` inside `body`, in which case `body` can never be exactly the fixed no-answer string. The reference engine took the second reading, so two conforming engines could differ. AGSC-09-14a as amended fixes the first reading and this vector pins it for a matching and a non-matching question: the AGSC-08-18 envelope — source, trust, license, type, body — with EXACTLY ONE added top-level member, `citations[]`, an array of item IRIs; `trust` fixed at `untrusted`; `body` the answer TEXT with the Content Use Terms line embedded in it; at least one item IRI cited for every answer; and, when nothing matches, `body` exactly `no answer in this memory` with an empty `citations[]`. Only the envelope shape and the fixed string are asserted — the wording of a matching answer is a responder's own and is deliberately unspecified, exactly as cli-0004 leaves a fault message unspecified.

arguments.question: what is the airspeed of an unladen swallow?
